settings.title: Settings
settings.syncOnClickHint: Sync: if no remote is configured, this page opens so you can add one; otherwise you choose a sync direction.

checkpoint.title: Sync checkpoint
checkpoint.hint: After each successful sync, this device keeps only the latest checkpoint (never uploaded). Restore to that point here.
checkpoint.needsLocal: Open a local workspace to manage checkpoints.
checkpoint.empty: No checkpoint yet. It is created automatically after a successful sync.
checkpoint.restoreConfirm: Restore the workspace to the latest sync checkpoint? Local-only files added since then will be removed, and modified files will revert to the checkpoint.
checkpoint.clearConfirm: Delete the local sync checkpoint? This cannot be undone.

settings.singleSyncHint: Only one repository can sync at a time. Pick the active target in the table.
settings.importConfirm: Import replaces every remote repository. Continue?
settings.importFailed: Could not read this configuration file

userConfig.title: Personal config backup
userConfig.hint: One pixuli-user-config file. Language and appearance by default. Optionally include remotes (contains tokens — share carefully).
userConfig.exportCopied: Personal config copied to the clipboard
userConfig.importConfirm: Import will overwrite language and appearance. Continue?
userConfig.importConfirmWithSources: Import will overwrite language, appearance, and replace all remotes. Continue?
userConfig.importFailed: Could not read this configuration file
userConfig.importSkippedOnly: No applicable settings found in this file

settings.sourcesEmpty: No remote connections yet. Use the button above to add GitHub or Gitee.
settings.wizardPurposeTitle: Choose how this connection is used
settings.wizardDoneHint: It will appear in the connection list. Sync does not start by itself.
settings.wizardEditDoneHint: Saves changes to this connection. Sync does not start by itself.
settings.wizardAuthUnavailable: No authorization method is available on this device.
settings.purposeBackupHint: Can sync, but is not the default sync target.

pat.validateFailed: Token is invalid. Check it and try again.
pat.loadReposFailed: Could not load repositories. Fill them in manually.
pat.pathHint: Sync root inside the repository. The default is usually fine.

settings.workspaceUnavailable: Local workspace is not supported on this platform.
settings.workspaceNoRemoteHint: No remote repository yet. Add one under Sync and set a sync target.
settings.workspacePhotosEmptyHint: Open Workspace in the sidebar to create or connect a local workspace before browsing images.
settings.appearanceHint: Choose the interface colors. System follows the operating system light or dark setting.
